One record per architecture decision, numbered in the order they were taken. A decision that replaces another says so in its record.

| ADR | Decision | Status | Date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [0001](./0001-typings-generated-from-raw-patch-files.md) | Typings are generated from vendored raw Patch files plus a hand-curated Overlay | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0002](./0002-toolchain-follows-tstl-and-tests-run-on-real-lua.md) | The toolchain follows typescript-to-lua's TypeScript peer, and library tests run the compiled Lua on real Lua 5.3 | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0003](./0003-creation-throws-lookup-returns-undefined.md) | Creation throws, lookup returns undefined; the Handle registry upgrades to the more specific Wrapper | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0004](./0004-tsdoc-standard-with-compiled-examples.md) | Doc comments follow TSDoc with declared custom tags, examples are included from compiled files, and library coverage is gated | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0005](./0005-docs-site-on-docusaurus-versioned-per-release.md) | The docs site runs on Docusaurus, is versioned per library release by CI, and generates the migration table from a rename map | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0006](./0006-template-owns-code-editor-owns-data.md) | The Template owns code, the World Editor owns data, and every library release must build the Template before it ships | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0007](./0007-guards-in-three-layers-behind-one-dev-flag.md) | Guards live in three layers, and the runtime layer sits behind one dev-mode flag | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0008](./0008-wrapper-coverage-rule-and-no-bj-mirroring.md) | Every Wrapper covers all natives owned by its handle type, measured by a generated report, and Blizzard.j is never mirrored | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
| [0009](./0009-independent-semver-with-changesets-and-patch-field.md) | Packages are versioned independently with Changesets, and each one declares the game Patch it supports | accepted | 2026-09-23 |
